mapper.sql: SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, category_code AS categoryCode, name, template_code AS templateCode, balance, fund_bucket AS fundBucket, insurance_type AS insuranceType, data_date AS dataDate, sort_order AS sortOrder, remark, version, source_type AS sourceType, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM financial_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.name, f.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, f.allow_view_others AS allowViewOthers, m.id AS currentMemberId FROM financial_family f JOIN financial_member m ON m.family_id=f.id AND m.tenant_id=f.tenant_id WHERE f.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, display_name AS displayName, role, sort_order AS sortOrder FROM financial_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT id, code, name, icon, color, description, sort_order AS sortOrder, enabled FROM financial_category WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_family SET name=#{name},allow_view_others=#{allow} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{familyId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM system_users WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND deleted=0 AND status=0
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_member SET user_id=#{userId},display_name=#{name},sort_order=#{sort} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM financial_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND member_id=#{memberId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM financial_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND member_id=#{memberId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM financial_update_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND member_id=#{memberId} LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM financial_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND id=#{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT code FROM financial_category WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM financial_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND category_code=#{code} AND deleted=0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_category SET name=#{name},icon=#{icon},color=#{color},description=#{description}, sort_order=#{sort},enabled=#{enabled} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id,r.account_id AS accountId,r.member_id AS memberId,r.category_code AS categoryCode, r.account_name AS accountName,r.previous_balance AS previousBalance, r.current_balance AS currentBalance,r.change_amount AS changeAmount,r.operation, r.source_type AS sourceType,r.data_date AS dataDate,r.created_at AS createdAt, r.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId,u.nickname AS operatorName FROM financial_update_record r LEFT JOIN system_users u ON u.id=r.operator_user_id AND u.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.family_id=#{familyId} AND r.member_id IN #{memberId} AND r.category_code<>'fixed' ORDER BY r.created_at,r.id
AND member_id IN #{memberId}
SELECT MAX(created_at) AS updatedAt FROM financial_update_record WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND member_id IN #{memberId}

SELECT r.id,r.batch_id AS batchId,r.account_id AS accountId,r.member_id AS memberId, r.category_code AS categoryCode,r.account_name AS accountName,r.previous_balance AS previousBalance, r.current_balance AS currentBalance,r.change_amount AS changeAmount,r.operation,r.source_type AS sourceType, r.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId,r.data_date AS dataDate,r.created_at AS createdAt, u.nickname AS operatorName FROM financial_update_record r LEFT JOIN system_users u ON u.id=r.operator_user_id AND u.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM financial_update_record r
SELECT id,operator_user_id AS operatorUserId,request_hash AS requestHash FROM financial_update_batch WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) AS date FROM financial_snapshot WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_account SET member_id=#{member},category_code=#{category},name=#{name},balance=#{balance}, fund_bucket=#{bucket},insurance_type=#{insurance},data_date=#{date},sort_order=#{sort},remark=#{remark}, updater=#{userId},deleted=#{deleted},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT template_code FROM financial_account WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND deleted=0 AND template_code IS NOT NULL GROUP BY member_id,template_code HAVING COUNT(*)>1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_update_batch SET total_assets=#{total},total_liabilities=#{liability},net_assets=#{net} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND family_id=#{familyId} AND id=#{id}

INSERT INTO financial_snapshot(tenant_id,family_id,member_id,snapshot_date,liquid_amount,fixed_amount, investment_amount,receivable_amount,liability_amount,total_assets,net_assets) VALUES(#{tenantId},#{familyId},#{memberId},#{date},#{liquid},#{fixed},#{investment},#{receivable},#{liability},#{total},#{net}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE liquid_amount=#{liquid},fixed_amount=#{fixed},investment_amount=#{investment}, receivable_amount=#{receivable},liability_amount=#{liability},total_assets=#{total},net_assets=#{net},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
